title: Playing Guitar
description: An auto-arranged tree: no coordinates anywhere, so it lays itself out wherever it's opened.
author: Claude

skills.name: Tune by ear
skills.description: Match strings to a reference pitch without an app.

skills.name: Hold a pick
skills.description: Grip and angle for clean, consistent strokes.

skills.name: Open chords
skills.description: E, A, D, G, C and their minors.

skills.name: Smooth chord changes
skills.description: Move between open chords in time without stopping.

skills.name: Strumming patterns
skills.description: Keep a steady hand through varied rhythms.

skills.name: Barre chords
skills.description: Fret a full barre cleanly and move shapes up the neck.

skills.name: Play a song end to end
skills.description: Combine chords and rhythm into a complete piece.

skills.name: Play with other people
skills.description: Hold your part while listening and staying in time.
